title: The Terms of *Entry*
dek: Apple gave Chinese Siri to Alibaba. Anthropic committed $600B in compute to go public. The admission prices for AI at scale are becoming visible.

still_signal: The institutions nominally in charge of AI's conditions are discovering, in each story today, that the conditions were already set without them.
